doc.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09

title: Pete's clarinet influences
summary: Pete cites Benny Goodman, Irving Fazola and George Lewis as influences.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Pete Fountain, I'd like to ask you, were you influenced much at all by Benny Goodman in any way?
I say Benny and Irvin Fazola. Benny's technique and Faz's sound, and his feeling for the blues.
Now, those would be the two clarinetes that are the most influenced on you, you would say.
And George Lewis, through the years.
